items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He said, “George enlightened me about a different way of playing music, an analytical way which enabled me to go on learning about music on my own.”

ctx.x: Is that right? Okay. They had the real jazz feeling, the urban.
Yeah. They were incredible. It was Jan Garbarek . . .
Okay. I was going to ask you about him.
